signalValue.note: Moreno Fisher committed to Florida on November 12, 2026. 2027 OT, Hough (Cornelius, NC), 6-7 / 270. Former Virginia. Official Oklahoma visit November 6–8. Phil Trautwein.

vaultScouting.evaluation: Fisher is a 6-7 length tackle in a conversion year — junior Independence tape is T/DE after he moved from defensive end to right tackle. The frame is the trait. Mass and a finished pass set are still coming. Basketball athlete at that height, so the feet are better than a lot of 6-7 tackles you see at 270.
vaultScouting.comparison: Fisher comps to Walker Little — 6-7 tackle length who filled out later; long-frame OT, not a finished 320-pound mauler yet (size-matched; not a Florida-alum default).
vaultScouting.projection: Fisher projects as Year 1 develop (add mass and clean up the pass set after the DE-to-OT conversion), Year 2 compete in the OT room, with starter-upside as a length tackle — not a rotational OT as the ceiling.
strengths: Fisher's listed 6-7 frame is the trait — rare tackle length and tackle-box reach you don't coach onto a shorter OT.
Fisher already made the DE-to-RT conversion as a junior — Independence tape is labeled T/DE because he is playing tackle, not a projection still standing up from the edge.
Fisher is a basketball athlete at that height — change of direction and foot quickness you don't always get in 6-7 tackles still listed 270.
vaultScouting.schemeFit: Fisher fits Trautwein's room as a length tackle who can grow into a zone/power hybrid once the mass arrives.
